name: Settings
description: Brand profile, style/tone, risk policy, monitored channels, and the agent lock

agentPrompts.label: Show our current brand profile and risk policy
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-brand` skill in this folder, then show me the brand profile, tone/reading level, banned or regulated language, and monitored channels. Never expose a secret value here.

agentPrompts.label: Update the brand profile or risk policy
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-brand` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then update the brand profile field or risk-policy item I describe (for example a banned phrase, a monitored channel, or the tone/reading level) directly on the settings row.
